THE PROBLEM

Machines are deaf to the world

Vision-only senses
Devices see and read text, yet ignore the sounds that signal what is happening around them.
Critical events go unheard
Glass breaking, alarms and impacts pass unnoticed unless a person is listening.
No sound intelligence layer
Teams have no ready-made way to add reliable hearing to a product.
Hearing is the missing sense in connected devices.
